harness.description: Linux-first post-exploitation C2 whose MCP server lets an AI harness operate it in natural language.

uses.quote: Over time it grew into a multi-operator C2 featuring modular Go and C agents, a self-healing P2P mesh, in-memory execution across Linux and Windows, and an OPSEC-screened MCP server that lets operators turn their own private AI harness into a fully interactive, natural-language C2 interface.
